Course sans fin sur une planète lointain: An endless run on a distant planet: jump over crystals (hold to jump higher, double jump in the air), stay on the ground under meteors, catch stars in a row for a multiplier up to ×4 and a shield to take a hit. The speed rises to more than double; score by distance and stars, record kept. Every 1000 m, a new planet (ice, lava, gas giant). Pixel art like the recent games, a bigger astronaut, big text, full screen.
